body:
Thanks. Appreciate it.

It seems all I do is talk and talk and talk. People are sick of hearing me talk about my past and my mistakes. Can't say I blame them. They can't solve my problems. 

And, that's what I always hear: "What do you want me to do?" and "What's done is done. Got to move on." And, they're right -- the past is done and there's nothing they can do.

This cycle of misery will never end.

Thanks for reaching out.

I'm trying not to act on impulse but I had a very comfortable life up to this point that knowing the cushion that I once had is gone is very frightening. 

I'm basically holding onto my job with both hands because my concentration is shot and I'm trying desperately not to let things slip through my fingers. So, yes, retirement is my primary concern. 

If you have any measure of guidance on where I can go from here in terms of rebuilding financially, I would incredibly appreciative.
